blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Watching another person interact with an object reveals more than its motion. We can anticipate how it articulates and form an expectation of the effort involved, using observed actions to guide our own ( Reichelt et al., 2013 ) . Giving robots a comparable understanding would make human video a source of both motion references and sensory expectations for planning and interaction. We study this capability through third-person video: estimating the trajectory of an articulated interaction together with its force or torque profile. On human video, this profile is what a gripper, the end effector of most robots, would need to apply in the same interaction, not the force exerted by the person.
blocks.zh: 看着另一个人与一个物体互动 所揭示的不只是它的动作 我们可以预见它如何阐明和形成对相关努力的期望,利用观察到的行动指导我们自己的行动(Reichelt等,2013年)。 给机器人一个类似的理解将使人类视频成为规划和互动方面的运动参考和感官期望的来源。 我们通过第三人称视频来研究这种能力:估计一种清晰互动的轨迹及其力量或扭矩特征。 在人类视频中,这个剖面图是大多数机器人的发牢骚者,最终效应者,需要应用在相同的相互作用中,而不是个人施加的力量.

blocks.en: Recent methods extract rich geometric and motion representations from interaction videos. CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) follows image points, D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) reconstructs and tracks dynamic scenes, and EgoInfinity ( Wang et al., 2026a ) recovers hand–object motion. VidBot ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and AFUN ( Wang et al., 2026b ) predict interaction trajectories from an RGB-D observation and a language prompt. While these capabilities capture how an interaction unfolds, they do not estimate the force or torque required to execute it. Supervising such estimates, however, comes with two critical challenges: (i) force and torque data require specialized measurement equipment, and such instrumented interaction data are therefore far scarcer than ordinary videos. (ii) Even with the limited available data, how can the extracted knowledge be transferred so that models can predict from uninstrumented human demonstrations?
blocks.zh: 最近的方法从互动视频中提取出丰富的几何和运动表现. CoTracker3(Karaev等,2025年)遵循图像点,D4RT(Zhang等,2026年)重建并跟踪动态场景,而EgoInfinity(Wang等,2026a)恢复了手-对象运动. VidBot (Chen等, 2025)和AFUN (Wang等, 2026b)预测从RGB-D观测和语言快取的相互作用轨迹. 虽然这些能力掌握了互动是如何展开的,但它们并不估计执行互动所需的力量或扭矩。 然而,监督这种估计有两个关键的挑战:(一) 强力和扭矩数据需要专门的测量设备,因此,这种仪器交互数据远比普通视频少。 (二) 即使现有数据有限,如何转让所取出的知识,使模型能够从无手段的人类演示中预测出?

blocks.en:
We address this gap by transferring sensory information across interactions that require comparable effort. VidForce captures this structure with a learned set of force prototypes, each encoding a characteristic force level and temporal profile. Vision–language features route each observation to relevant prototypes, while observed geometry and appearance adapt the resulting prior to the observed interaction. By organizing these prototypes around measured effort rather than predefined object categories, the model connects limited instrumented supervision to uninstrumented human video without supervising or fixing any object taxonomy. To adapt the prototype to the observed instance, a joint conditional flow couples trajectory and force prediction. Given an initial trajectory estimate from a motion tracker, the flow refines this proposal and the adapted force prior.
During training, force measurements from instrumented-gripper recordings provide reference targets for paired human videos. At inference, the contact point and prompt may be supplied or inferred from the video. The same formulation can be extended to other sensory quantities; we demonstrate this with a separately trained torque model.

在培训期间,从仪器-格氏录相中测量出的力量为配对的人类视频提供了参考目标. 推断出,可以从视频中提供或推断出联络点和即时. 同样的配方可以扩展到其他感官数量;我们用一个经过单独训练的扭矩模型来证明这一点。

blocks.en: • We formulate sensory-aware articulation understanding from third-person video: jointly recovering interaction trajectory and a force profile, with optional contact and language guidance. • We introduce VidForce, a model that predicts the effort of an observed interaction in the form of force profiles. The model organizes observations by measured effort into learned force prototypes and jointly refines the resulting prior and a tracked trajectory. This design makes effective use of the limited available data without relying on predefined object categories. • We evaluate trajectory and sensory prediction against matched baselines and isolate the contributions of key model components and input sources through controlled ablations. We further assess video-only inference on real-world recordings outside the training dataset and conduct success-rate trials on a Spot robot using the predicted trajectories and force profiles for manipulation.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们从第三人称视频中形成感知的表达理解:联合恢复相互作用轨迹和力量简介,可选的接触和语言指导。 我们引入了"维德福斯"(VidForce),这个模型预测了以部队剖面形式观察到的互动的努力. 该模型通过有分量的努力将观测组织成有学识的力量原型,并共同完善了由此产生的前轨和有轨迹。 这种设计在不依赖预先定义的对象类别的情况下,有效地利用有限的现有数据。 我们对照相应的基线来评价轨迹和感官预测,并通过受控活化来隔离关键模型组件和输入源的贡献. 我们进一步评估对训练数据集以外真实世界录音的仅用视频的推论,并利用预测的轨迹和力量剖面进行Spot机器人的成功率试验来进行操纵。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Interaction and articulation from human video. Human video can supply motion cues for robot learning without robot action labels: point tracks condition policies ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Jain et al., 2024 ) , reconstructed object motion supports imitation ( Kerr et al., 2024 ) , and object-centric 3D motion fields provide metric geometry ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) tracks points through occlusion, D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) combines tracking with dynamic 3D reconstruction, EgoInfinity ( Wang et al., 2026a ) recovers metric hand–object motion, and Articulate-Anything ( Le et al., 2025 ) constructs articulated simulation assets. Affordance models such as VidBot ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and AFUN ( Wang et al., 2026b ) use visual observations and language prompts to predict interaction trajectories. These methods capture where and how an interaction unfolds, but not the required force or torque; VidForce builds on D4RT by initializing from its trajectory estimate and conditioning joint trajectory–force prediction on the full motion field.

blocks.en: Force inference from video. Ehsani et al. (2020) infer force by matching simulated object motion to video, while ForceSight ( Collins et al., 2024 ) predicts a single robot-centric force goal from RGB-D and language. Li et al. (2019) recover person and tool motion with contact forces from monocular video by optimizing full-body dynamics, for rigid tools without articulation, and EgoPHI ( Ilic et al., 2026 ) predicts per-vertex contact and normal force from a single egocentric image and the object mesh, trained on simulated forces. VidForce jointly predicts a temporal force profile and interaction trajectory of articulated objects from third-person human video, using paired human and gripper recordings to transfer measured force supervision. Recent methods use measured force to transfer human demonstrations to robots: FeelTheForce ( Adeniji et al., 2025 ) learns contact-driven policies from demonstrations with hand-force measurements, and ReForce ( Wu et al., 2026 ) retargets hand motion while accounting for contact forces. VidForce addresses the complementary problem of estimating this missing force signal from video, where robots can use the predicted force profile for force-aware control (Sec. 4.3 ).

Touch and Go ( Yang et al., 2022 ) learns visual–tactile correspondence, TVL ( Fu et al., 2024 ) aligns touch with vision–language representations, FEEL ( Dessalene et al., 2026 ) pairs egocentric video with measured hand forces for pretraining, and TouchAnything ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) predicts bimanual pressure maps. ( Engelbracht et al., 2026 ) provides paired bare-hand and instrumented-gripper recordings across viewpoints; VidForce uses the gripper measurements to supervise gripper videos and provide force references for paired human interactions, then shares this supervision through learned prototypes organized by effort.

blocks.en: Learned prototype and mixture priors. Mixture-of-experts models ( Jacobs et al., 1991 ; Shazeer et al., 2017 ) route inputs to jointly learned specialists, discrete codebooks ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ) learn finite latent sets and serve as human-motion priors ( Lucas et al., 2022 ) , and prototype networks ( Snell et al., 2017 ; Chen et al., 2019 ) represent classes through learned exemplars. VidForce combines these ideas but organizes its prototypes by measured effort: a routing loss associates each training interaction with nearby force levels, while the levels, temporal shapes, and semantic keys are learned jointly with the router. Their log-force levels and temporal shapes are mixed softly, yielding a force prior without class labels or a reconstruction objective.
blocks.zh: 学过原型和混合前科 专家混合模型(Jacobs等,1991年;Shazeer等,2017年) 向联合学习的专家提供路线投入,离散代码本(van den) Oord等人, 2017 )学习有限度的潜伏相机并充当人类运动前作(Lucas等, 2022 ),而原型网络(Snell等, 2017;Chen等, 2019 )则通过所学实例代表班级. VidForce结合了这些想法,但通过有分量的努力来组织它的原型:一条路由损失连接了每次训练与相邻部队水平的互动,而水平,时间形状,和语义键则与路由器一起被学习. 它们的对数力水平和时间形状柔和地混合在一起,在没有分类标签或重建目标的情况下产生先发力.

blocks.en:
We present an overview of our method in Figure 1 .
Given a video clip V V , a sequence of 32 RGB frames showing one interaction from a static third-person camera and cropped to an object-centric window around the manipulated object, VidForce predicts a camera-space contact trajectory 𝐏 = ( 𝐩 i ) i = 1 N \mathbf{P}=(\mathbf{p}_{i})_{i=1}^{N} at N = 16 N{=}16 waypoints, a force-magnitude profile 𝐟 ∈ ℝ ≥ 0 L \mathbf{f}\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{L} over L = 32 L{=}32 samples of normalized interaction time, and a separate peak estimate F F . Visual and language features route the observation to learned force prototypes, which initialize the force prediction. A joint conditional flow then refines this prediction together with the tracked trajectory. The same formulation applies to other sensory channels; a separately trained model predicts sensor-frame torque.

blocks.en: Figure 1: VidForce overview. The model takes an RGB video, with an optional contact click and text describing the object and its motion. Frozen D4RT, DA3, and Qwen3-VL backbones extract motion, geometry, visual, and language features. blocks.en: 3.1 Representing the observed interaction
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 代表观察到的互动

blocks.en: Three frozen models extract complementary information (motion, depth, semantics) from the clip and atrainable transformer fuses these representations, while the tracks provide an initial trajectory proposal. D4RT tracks points throughout the clip to form a motion field. The median displacement of valid tracks near the contact defines the initial trajectory proposal 𝐁 \mathbf{B} . DA3 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) estimates depth and camera intrinsics 𝐊 \mathbf{K} . Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) provides visual features and the prompt embedding 𝐞 ⁡ ( q ) \mathbf{e}(q) . Rather than a generic text embedding, 𝐞 ⁡ ( q ) \mathbf{e}(q) contains the square-rooted probabilities assigned to 256 answer tokens and the two actions when Qwen3-VL is asked which part is manipulated and whether it opens or closes (Appendix A.1 ). blocks.en: The sensory prior consists of learned force prototypes that capture force levels and temporal profiles shared across interactions of comparable effort. A router weights these prototypes using visual and language features, and an adaptation head adjusts the resulting prior to the observed interaction. The prior can be of arbitrary size, and we choose K = 10 K{=}10 prototypes for all our experiments as the largest K K for which every prototype remains in use (Appendix C.8 ). Each prototype comprises a log-force level a k a_{k} , a shape 𝐬 k ∈ ℝ L \mathbf{s}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{L} , and a learned semantic key 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} . The level describes how much force is expected, the shape describes how it varies through the interaction, and the key is matched against language features during routing. We normalize the force profile by the separately predicted peak, 𝝈 = 𝐟 / F \boldsymbol{\sigma}=\mathbf{f}/F , separating magnitude and temporal shape.

blocks.en: 3.3 Joint conditional flow for motion and effort

blocks.en: A joint conditional flow predicts residual corrections to the trajectory proposal and adapted force prior, allowing motion and effort to exchange information during refinement. The resulting residual is decoded into the final trajectory, peak force, and force profile, scaled so that its maximum equals the peak. The correction has three parts—waypoint offsets from the tracked trajectory, a log-scale change in peak force, and changes to the temporal shape—concatenated into one residual state: 𝐫 = [ vec ⁡ ( 𝐗 − 𝐁 ) , log ⁡ max ⁡ ( F , ϵ ) F ¯ ′ , 𝝈 − 𝝈 ¯ ′ ] ∈ ℝ 3 ​ N + 1 + L . \mathbf{r}=\left[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{X}-\mathbf{B}),\;\log\frac{\max(F,\epsilon)}{\bar{F}^{\prime}},\;\boldsymbol{\sigma}-\bar{\boldsymbol{\sigma}}^{\prime}\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{3N+1+L}. (3) The operator vec \operatorname{vec} stacks the waypoint offsets into a vector. The adapted prior enters the target with gradients detached, so the flow learns residuals around a fixed reference and the prior is shaped only by its own loss. A DiT-style transformer velocity field ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) processes the residual tokens jointly. It attends to 𝐌 \mathbf{M} and is conditioned on 𝐠 \mathbf{g} , the tracked proposal, and motion-derived features. Waypoint tokens receive tracked motion around the contact, while force tokens receive speed, acceleration, and displacement statistics. This joint conditioning lets motion and effort inform one another without imposing a force–acceleration relation.

blocks.en: Training. Hoi! ( Engelbracht et al., 2026 ) supplies tracked trajectories for human and gripper recordings (Sec. 4.1 ) and force measurements for the gripper. A human recording inherits the peak and normalized profile of the paired gripper recording of the same episode, possibly from another camera, as a down-weighted reference for the corresponding gripper force a robot would need. This assumes that the shared object and action mainly set the required force; differences in speed and contact location between gripper and human video pairs are not modeled. This holds the force function fixed while trajectory training continues, allowing one checkpoint to serve both outputs (Appendix A.4 ).

blocks.en: Inference. Inference requires no force or torque measurements. The model takes a clip spanning one interaction; untrimmed recordings are delimited to the span in which the object moves, following the data pipeline of Sec. 4.1 (Appendix D ). A manual click centers the window on the contact. Without a click, the vision–language model proposes the contact, optionally refined by a localization head. The motion field is then re-anchored on this proposal in a second pass ( self-click ). The object–action prompt can likewise be supplied or written by the same model from the frames ( self-prompt ); the questions are given in Appendix A.5 . The torque model follows the same procedure with sensor-frame torque targets and its own prototypes.
blocks.zh: 推论. 推论不需要强制或扭矩测量. 模型取出一个跨越一个相互作用的剪接;未被剪接的录音按照Sec 4.1的数据管道(附录D)被划分为对象移动的间距. 手动点击将窗口放在联系人上 。 在不点击的情况下,视觉-语言模型提出接触,由本地化头可选地改进. 然后,在第二次通过(自点击)时,动议字段将重新对本提案进行选择。 object-action 提示也可以由相同的模型从帧(自发)中提供或写入;这些问题在附录A.5中给出. 扭矩模型采用传感器-帧扭矩目标及其自有原型的相同程序.

blocks.en: We evaluate trajectory recovery, force and torque estimation, and the contribution of the learned prototype prior and the joint flow (Sec. 4.2 ). The prior study also tests limited sensory supervision (Table 5 ); separate analyses examine paired transfer to human video and input guidance (Sec. 4.2 ). Real-world videos and a robot deployment examine predictions beyond the recorded dataset (Sec. 4.3 ); the data, protocol, and baselines are described first (Sec. 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价轨迹恢复、力和扭矩估计以及所学原型在前和联合流动中的贡献(第4.2节)。 先前的研究还测试了有限的感官监督(表5);单独的分析检查了配对到人类视频的转移和输入指导(第4.2条)。 真实世界的视频和一个机器人的部署检查了记录数据集以外的预测(第4.3条);首先描述了数据、协议和基线(第4.1条)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Data. We train and evaluate on Hoi! ( Engelbracht et al., 2026 ) , which contains paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings of everyday articulated-object interactions viewed from two static cameras. Gripper recordings provide measured force and torque, while paired human recordings support transfer to bare-hand video (Sec. 3.4 ).
Each sequence represents one interaction from one camera and one embodiment, sampled to 32 frames, cropped to the model’s object window (Sec. 3 ), and annotated with the first-frame contact and the dataset prompt. Because occlusions can hide the contact or articulated motion, we verify contact visibility by a depth-ray test, and check whether at least half of the motion is in view, and the trajectory plausible.
Using these checks, we retain 630 sequences (343 gripper and 287 human).
Appendix B details the pipeline and rejected examples.
blocks.zh:
数据。 我们在Hoi训练和评价! (Engelbracht等,2026年),包含从两台静相机上查看的每日被拼接的物体相互作用的成对人和仪表-gripper记录. Gripper录音提供了量度强度和扭矩,而配对的人类录音则支持向裸体视频的传输(第3.4条)。
每个序列代表一个相机和一个相机的相互作用,取样到32帧,裁剪到模型的对象窗口(Sec. 3)上,并用第一帧接头和数据集快取来注释. 由于被隔离可以隐藏接触或被清晰地显示的运动,我们通过深射线测试来验证接触能见度,并检查至少一半的运动是否在可见,轨迹是否可信.
使用这些检查,我们保留了630个序列(343个抓取器和287个人).
附 录 B详细介绍了管道和被否决的例子。

blocks.en: Training. We train on a train split of 531 sequences (295 gripper, 236 human), increasing data diversity through shifted crops, rescaling around the object, and flipping (Appendix B.4 ). Sequences with measured force targets have weight 1 and paired references weight 0.5 in the peak and shape terms. On 30 % of the training recordings, the contact is perturbed and the click-seeded tracks are dropped (click-free rows), so that the model also works from a proposed contact. More details can be found in Appendix B.4 and A.2 .
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们用531个序列(295个抓取器,236个人类)的列车进行分解,通过改变的作物来增加数据的多样性,在物体周围调整,并翻转(附录B.4.). 有被测量出力目标的序列在峰值和形状上有重量1和对比参考重量0.5. 在30%的训练录相上,接触被扰动,并放下了被点击的音轨(无点击行),因此该模型也从一个拟议接触中工作. 详见附录B.4和A.2。

blocks.en: Evaluation. The evaluation set ( Eval ) contains 99 sequences (48 gripper, 51 human) with a manual click and a manual prompt . It combines 47 sequences (23 gripper) from an unseen room type —the only living room among the 20 Hoi! scenes—and 52 sequences (25 gripper) from interactions with held-out objects in ten training scenes. Self-click and self-prompt (Sec. 3.4 ) replace the manual click and manual prompt with Qwen3-VL proposals using the same checkpoints. Both manual-click and self-click runs use depth predicted by DA3. Manual-click runs sample this depth at the annotated contact pixel, whereas self-click runs sample it at the contact pixel predicted by Qwen. Tracker baselines receive the same proposed point (Appendix C.1 ). Unless stated otherwise, every evaluation uses three training seeds and reports mean ± \pm sample SD at the final checkpoint; deterministic trajectory baselines are run once.
blocks.zh: 评价。 评估集(Eval )包含99个序列(48个抓取者,51个人类),有手动点击和手动提示. 它将47个序列(23个抓取者)从一个看不见的房间类型——20个Hoi!场景中唯一的起居室——和52个序列(25个抓取者)从10个训练场景中与被搁置物体的互动中结合在一起. 自选和自选(第3.4节)用相同的检查站用Qune3-VL提案取代手动点击和手动提示。 手动点击和自击都使用DA3预测的深度运行. 手动点击在附加说明的接触像素上运行此深度的样本,而自点击在Quen预测的接触像素上运行样本. 跟踪基线得到相同的拟议点(附录C.1)。 除非另有说明,每一次评价都使用三个训练种子,报告表示在最后检查站采样为±\pm;确定性轨迹基线运行一次。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Trajectory and force predictions. Top: ground-truth and predicted contact trajectories in the object-centric window. All trajectory methods receive the manual click , and the lower strip reports each method’s ATE in cm using its line color. Bottom: predicted force profiles and peak estimates against measured force; the human sequence uses its paired gripper reference.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 轨迹和力预测. 顶部:以物体为中心窗口中的地真和预测接触轨迹. 所有轨迹方法都收到手动点击,下行条则使用其行色以cm来报告每种方法的ATE. 底部:预测出的力量剖面和相对于被测量出的力量的峰值估计;人类序列使用其配对的抓取器参考.

blocks.en: Metrics. ATE (cm) is the mean waypoint error per sequence after translation-only alignment of the predicted and measured starts, reported as the median across sequences. ADE is the same error without the alignment. Peak MAE and RMSE compare one predicted peak with one measured peak per instrumented sequence. Profile RMSE is the RMS error over the 32 normalized-time samples of the profile scaled to the predicted peak, aggregated by RMS across sequences. Force errors are reported in N and torque errors in N m.
blocks.zh: Metrics. ATE (cm) 是在对所预测和所测量的起步进行仅由翻译对齐后,作为跨序列中位数报告的每个序列的平均中位点出错. ADE 没有对齐是相同的错误. 峰值MAE和RMSE将一个预测峰值与每个仪器测得的峰值作一比较. Profile RMSE是32个正常时间的剖面样本被缩放到预测峰值上的RMS错误,由RMS跨序列相加. 强制出错以N为单位报告,而扭矩出错以N m为单位报告.

blocks.en:
Baselines. No prior method predicts trajectory and force profiles of articulated-object interactions from third-person video (Sec. 2 ), so we use separate baselines.
All trajectory baselines receive the same clip and contact and are evaluated at the same 16 waypoints. D4RT provides the tracked initialization without learned refinement. CoTracker3 tracks the contact pixel and lifts it to 3D using DA3 depth. Articulate-Anything ( Le et al., 2025 ) reconstructs an articulated asset from the video; we register it to the contact and CoTracker3 track, then animate its predicted joint range at constant speed. EgoInfinity ( Wang et al., 2026a ) reconstructs the hand and uses the joint nearest the contact; we evaluate it only on human interactions. For force, GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) estimates the peak from eight frames, with or without object–action text. ForceSight ( Collins et al., 2024 ) predicts the force a robot should apply from one RGB-D frame and a prompt; its released model was trained on a robot wrist camera. We evaluate it in the Hoi! gripper-mounted view—closest to its training setting—and in our third-person view. We test the released checkpoint zero-shot, a fine-tuned version on our data, and an adapted variant that replaces the force-goal output with a per-frame force prediction.
Appendix C.2 details all baselines.
blocks.zh:
基线。 没有先前的方法可以预测从第三人称视频(Sec. 2)中表达的物体相互作用的轨迹和力剖面,所以我们使用单独的基线.
所有轨迹基线都得到同样的剪接和接触,并在同一16个路口进行评估。 D4RT提供履带式初始化,而无需学习到完善. CoTracker3跟踪接触像素,并用DA3深度将其提升到3D. 艺术-任何东西(Le et al., 2025年)从视频中重建出一个清晰的资产;我们把它注册到接触和CoTracker3轨道,然后以恒定速度激活其预测的联合范围。 Ego Infinity(Wang等,2026a)重建手部并使用接触最接近的接合;我们只评价人类的相互作用. 对于强制,GPT-5.5(OpenAI,2026)从8个帧估算出峰值,有或没有对象-动作文本. ForceSight(Collins等,2024年)预测一个机器人应该从一个RGB-D框架和一个快件应用的力;其所发布的模型被训练在一个机器人腕相机上. 我们在Hoi里评估! 我们的第三人称观点。 我们测试了已发布的检查点零射出,我们的数据上一个精细的版本,以及一个将部队目标输出替换为每帧部队预测的被修改的变体.
附录C.2详细列出了所有基线。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Trajectory estimation. VidForce achieves the lowest ATE among all baselines, reducing the error from 11.8 cm for its D4RT initialization to 6.6 ± 0.4 6.6\pm 0.4 cm (Table 2 ). Both video-free references and Articulate-Anything remain substantially worse, showing that neither category-level motion nor a registered articulation alone recovers the observed instance trajectory.
blocks.zh: 轨迹估计. VidForce在所有基线中实现了最低的ATE,将D4RT初始化的错误从11.8厘米减少到6.6±0.4 6.6\pm 0.4厘米(表2)。 无视频参考文献和Articulate-Anything仍然严重恶化,表明无论是类别级运动还是仅登记在案的表述都无法恢复所观察到的实例轨迹。

blocks.en: Table 1: Trajectory estimation. ATE and ADE for manual and Qwen3-VL contacts. VidForce is best for both embodiments.
blocks.zh: 表1:轨迹估计。 ATE 和 ADE 用于手动和Quen3-VL 联系人. 维德福斯最适合两个化身

blocks.en: Table 2: Force and torque estimation. GPT-5.5 uses eight frames. † Gripper-view ForceSight is scored once per episode.
blocks.zh: 表2:强迫和扭矩估计。 GPT-5.5使用8帧. Gripper-view ForceSight每集评分一次.

blocks.en:
The largest gains occur when contact-seeded tracking fails to follow the object, particularly under gripper occlusion. The same ordering holds for human and gripper recordings and for Qwen3-VL-proposed contacts (Table 2 ).
The examples in Fig. 2 illustrate this pattern. EgoInfinity follows the visible hand during the refrigerator opening (a), but the trackers and registered asset miss the cupboard motion (b), and gripper occlusion leaves the drawer baselines near their starting point (c). VidForce recovers the object motion in both cases.
blocks.zh:
最大的收益发生在接触种子跟踪无法跟踪对象时,特别是在被夹住后. 人类和抓取者录音和Qune3-VL-拟议联系的相同订单(表2)。
图2中的例子说明了这一模式。 Ego Infinity在冰箱打开(a)时跟随可见的手,但追踪器和已注册资产错过了橱柜运动(b),而抓取器被遮住后,抽屉的基线会离其起点(c)相近. VidForce在两种情况下都恢复了物体运动.

blocks.en:
Force and torque estimation. VidForce achieves the lowest peak and profile errors among the third-person force methods (Table 2 ), reducing peak MAE from 6.85 N for GPT-5.5 to 4.81 ± 0.38 4.81\pm 0.38 N. Errors remain concentrated in the heaviest interactions, which the model tends to underestimate.
ForceSight is strongly affected by camera viewpoint. Its released model predicts nearly constant low force goals. The adapted variant calibrates the force scale and adds a profile, but remains less accurate than VidForce in the third-person view (Table 2 ; Fig. 2 ; Appendix C.2 ).
Table 2 also evaluates sensor-frame torque, validating the applicability of our general approach to other modalities.
blocks.zh:
力和力估计. VidForce在第三人称力方法中实现了最低峰值和剖面误差(表2),将峰值MAE从GPT-5.5的6.85 N降低到4.81±0.38 4.81\pm 0.38 N. 出错仍然集中在最重的相互作用上,模型往往低估了这种相互作用.
强视受到相机视角的强烈影响. 其发布的模型预测出近乎恒定的低能目标. 被改编的变体校正了力平面并增加了一个剖面图,但在第三人称视图(表2;图2;附录C.2)中仍然不如VidForce准确.
表2还评估了传感器-帧扭矩,证实了我们的一般方法对其他模式的适用性。

blocks.en: How data-efficient is VidForce? Force data is expensive to acquire, so VidForce has to learn from limited sensory data. We test data-efficiency by retraining the learned prototypes and the global prior by partially withholding measurements from training episodes, stratified by object and action; withheld episodes keep their videos and motion labels but contribute no force targets, paired references, or prior statistics (Table 5 ). We observe that even with a quarter of the measurement data, VidForce still outperforms all baselines of Table 2 . The learned prior provides a good initialization (Table 5 , right), which lowers the burden on the flow for refinement. With half of the force labels, it beats the global prior with all of them, for five or ten prototypes alike (Table 28 ).
blocks.zh: VidForce的数据效率如何? 强制数据需要花费去获取,因此维德福斯必须从有限的感官数据中学习. 我们通过再培训学到的原型和全球先测试数据效率,先从培训中部分扣取测量数据,然后按对象和行动进行分级;被扣取的片段保留其视频和运动标签,但不能提供武力目标、对准参考或先前的统计数据(表5)。 我们观察到,即使有四分之一的测量数据,维德福斯的表现仍然超过表2的所有基线。 所学的先入为出(表5,正确),可以减轻流量的负担,以供改进。 有了一半的分量标签,它就超越了全球所有分量的分量,5或10个原型相同(表28)。

blocks.zh: 表3:有限的部队监督。 峰地MAE(N)在一部分训练节目(左)上标有强制标签,每阶段后100%监督(右). 完整的衡量标准:表27。

blocks.zh: 表4:以前类型。 峰值MAE被测量到的峰值和尾部对象("其他")所分出. 单词列表和检索在测试时使用GT类信息. 平顶RMSE:表23和表38.

blocks.en: What do learned prototypes and routing contribute? With instance adaptation and joint flow fixed, learned prototypes with routing supervision outperform both a parameter-matched MLP prior, which maps the video and prompt features directly to a peak and profile, and the shared global prior of Sec. 3.2 in peak and profile error (Table 5 ), and they model heavy and tail forces well. Removing routing supervision raises peak MAE, indicating that prototype capacity alone does not account for the gain (Appendix C.5 ). Accuracy is stable from 5 to 30 prototypes, and beyond 10 some stay unused (Appendix C.8 ).
blocks.zh: 所学的原型和路线有什么贡献? 随着实例适应和联合流动的固定,具有路由监督功能的已学习的原型既超越了参数匹配的MLP前作,将视频和即时特性直接映射到一个峰值和剖面,也超越了在峰值和剖面误差(表5)中共享的Sec 3.2前作的全局性原型,它们很好地模拟了重力和尾力. 取消路由监理会提高峰值MAE,表明原型容量本身不计入收益(附录C.5.). 精确度稳定在从5到30个原型,超过10个部分未使用(附录C.8.

blocks.en: How do learned prototypes compare with other prior types? The word lists group the training measurements by four object names and two actions. The category of a sequence is either its GT category or one that an LLM assigns from this list based on the prompt. Learned prototypes match both word lists in peak MAE (Table 5 ) and peak RMSE (5.92 vs. 5.85–5.91 N; Table 38 ), without category information at test time. Other priors are best on single subsets, the direct MLP below 20 N and the LLM-assigned word list on peaks ≥ \geq 20 N, whereas VidForce is best overall, on tail objects and in profile RMSE, and holistically the most accurate prior. Flat clusters, which assign each prompt to its nearest of ten k k -means clusters, are less accurate than the prototypes and the word lists.
blocks.zh: 与其他前作类型相比,学到的原型是如何比较的? 该词将训练测量分为四个对象名和两个动作. 序列的类别要么是它的GT类别,要么是LLM根据提示从列表中指定的类别. 所学的原型在MAE峰值(表5)和RMSE峰值(5.92对5.85-5.91 N;表38)中都符合单词表,没有测试时的类别信息。 其他前科最好出现在单子集上,直接位于20 N以下的MLP和最高峰上由LLM分配的单词列表\\geq 20 N上,而VidForce在总体上最好,在尾部对象和剖面RMSE上,整体上最准确的前科. 平板集群,将每个快取分配给最接近的10 k-表示集群,其精确度低于原型和单词列表.

blocks.en:
Does the joint flow improve the correction, and what do the motion cues contribute? Flow matching improves prediction over one-shot regression, which predicts the same residual in a single step with the same network (Table 5 , Prediction head ).
The joint flow also improves on separate trajectory and force streams that share the conditioner but do not attend to each other. The flow complements the prior and the adaptation (Table 5 , right): after the learned prior, it changes the peak little and refines the trajectory (Table 2 ); if the prior is not good, as with one global prior ( K = 1 K{=}1 ), the flow does the heavy correction. The dense motion field contributes to both outputs: removing it significantly increases force prediction errors. Appendix C.7 reports the complete comparison.
blocks.zh:
联合流动是否改善了校正,运动提示有什么贡献? 流量匹配比一发反射更能改进预测,在同一个网络(表5,预测头.)的单步中预测相同的残留.
联合出行还改善了分道通航道和力流,这些通航道和力流共享调理器而互不关心. 流量补充了先前和适应(表5,右):在所学到的之前之后,它很少改变峰值并精炼出轨迹(表2);如果前流不妙,像一个全球前流(K=1K{=}1)一样,流量进行重修正. 密集运动场对两种输出都有贡献:去除它会大大增加力预测出错. 附录C.7报告了完整的比较情况。

blocks.en: Does paired supervision improve force transfer to human video? Paired supervision carries measured gripper force to human video (Table 5 , Human video ; Appendix C.10 for more): without it, the human-video peak disagreement with the paired gripper references rises from 10.64 10.64 to 18.79 18.79 N and the profile error rises too, while the trajectory error stays similar.
blocks.zh: 配对监督是否改善了向人类视频的转移? Paired 监制将量度的抓取力带入到人视频(表5, 人视频;附录C.10另加):没有它,人-video 峰值与配对的抓取者引用的分歧从10.64 10.64升至18.79 18.79 N 和 profile 错误也上升, 而轨迹错误保持不变 。

blocks.en: Can the click and prompt be automated? Both generated inputs keep force prediction close to the manual setting (Table 5 , Guidance ). The automated self-click has errors within std of the full model, while the automated prompt slightly reduces force prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 点击和提示能否自动化? 这两种投入都使力量预测接近于手工设定(表5,指导)。 自动自击在全模型的std内有出错,而自动快取会略微地降低力预测的准确性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Real-World Interactions, Robot Deployment, and Simulation
blocks.zh: 4.3 实际世界互动、机器人部署和模拟

blocks.en: We test VidForce beyond Hoi! through separate video and robot studies (protocols in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们测试威德福斯超越霍伊! 通过单独的视频和机器人研究(附录D中的议定书)。

blocks.en: Real-world videos. We record seven phone videos of a person repeatedly opening and closing six kitchen objects—a refrigerator door, freezer, cabinet door, drawer, oven door, and dishwasher door—at varying speeds and extents. We divide them into 46 episodes of 32 frames, each spanning contact to the end of motion. We evaluate the repeatability of the predictions, action and motion direction, and agreement between predicted peaks and the scale readings (Appendix D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 真实世界视频. 我们录制了7个电话录像,其中一人以不同的速度和程度多次打开并关闭了6个厨房物品——一个冰箱门、冰箱、柜子门、抽屉、烤箱门和洗碗机门。 我们把它们分为46集,共32个相框, 每一个相接到运动结束。 我们评价预测、行动和运动方向的可重复性,以及预测的峰值和尺度读取之间的一致(附录D.1 )。

blocks.en: With self-click and self-prompt, VidForce produces distinct force estimates across actions and objects (Fig. 3 b). Every object receives a higher predicted peak for opening than for closing. blocks.en: Robot deployment. Spot records human demonstrations with its arm camera, and VidForce predicts the contact trajectory and force profile of each with self-click and self-prompt. We execute the trajectories on a drawer and an oven door from two viewpoints, without force, with a constant force, and with the predicted force profile, under the same controller settings (Table 6 ). The predicted trajectories carry over across joint types and viewpoints: the drawer opens from the trajectory alone, even when loaded. The force profile lets Spot open the high-effort oven door, which stays shut without force and under the constant force. Without force feedback, small trajectory errors on revolute doors cause excessive force ( Wang et al., 2025b ) ; to prevent damage from such a force build-up, we set a safe limit on the gripper force that stops a run. In a systematic constant-force sweep, analyzed in Appendix D.2 , a constant 60 N opened the oven door relatively quickly but hit our safe limit (Fig. 6 ). A constant force calibrated well for each object or category can also achieve similar success, as on the drawer. However, a constant force can overshoot at first contact ( Ji et al., 2026 ) or slam the panel (Table 7 ); a smoothly rising profile such as ours avoids both. With the force profile and trajectory predicted by VidForce, Spot can execute the full articulation safely (Fig. 6 ).

blocks.en: Simulation. In MuJoCo, we open hand-built twins of a drawer (empty, with 3.4 kg of small objects, or with a 35 kg block) and of an oven door with a demonstrated force profile and constant forces (Table 7 ; Appendix D.3 ). The profile opens all three drawers with zero impact energy. A constant pull at the peak force keeps accelerating the drawer, resulting in high impact energy. A force profile leads to a low-impact, controlled articulation even when the full dynamics are unknown, while a constant force must be calibrated by hand for each object ( Jain et al., 2010 ; Jain & Kemp, 2013 ) .
blocks.zh: 模拟. 在MujoCo,我们打开一个抽屉(空地,有3.4公斤小物体,或35公斤块)和一个烤箱门的手造双胞胎,并展示出力量特征和恒力(表7;附录D.3)。 简介以零撞击能打开了所有三个抽屉. 在峰值力下不断拉动会不断加速抽屉,从而产生高冲击能. 力量剖面会导致低影响,可控的表达,即使整个动态未知,而恒定的力量必须用手来校正每个物体(Jain等人,2010;Jain & Kemp,2013.).

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: VidForce estimates typical interaction effort. Direct human-force measurements would complement paired gripper supervision and support person-specific predictions, while broader force data would help distinguish visually similar objects with different resistance and refine estimates for high-effort interactions. Our evaluation focuses on visible interactions, with metric scale estimated from monocular depth. Future work will expand object-centric data to interactions with distinct force signatures, such as stapler use and USB insertion at varying speeds. We plan to extend tracking to moving cameras and multiple viewpoints, and explore joint trajectory and force prediction from a single image.
blocks.zh: VidForce估计了典型的互动努力. 直接的人力测量将补充对接式抓取器的监督和支持针对个人的预测,而更广泛的力数据将有助于区分具有不同阻力的视相类似物体并改进对高功率相互作用的估计。 我们的评价侧重于可见的相互作用,其度量尺度是从单子深度估计的。 今后的工作将扩大以物体为中心的数据,使之能与不同的强力签名进行互动,例如使用定本器和以不同速度插入USB。 我们计划将跟踪扩展到移动相机和多角度,并探索联合轨迹和从单一图像进行力预测。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: VidForce brings sensory estimation to articulated-object understanding by jointly predicting a contact trajectory and force profile from third-person video. Learned physical prototypes share limited instrumented measurements across interactions of comparable effort; geometric and vision–language features adapt this prior to the observation, and a conditional flow refines it together with a tracked trajectory. VidForce improves trajectory recovery over every baseline and achieves the lowest force errors among third-person methods on held-out Hoi! interactions. A separately trained torque model further shows that the formulation can extend to other sensory quantities. The model produces consistent motion and force predictions on real-world videos, and enables robots to articulate objects safely. These results show how limited instrumented data can enrich ordinary interaction videos with estimates of how objects move and how much effort their manipulation may require.
blocks.zh: VidForce通过从第三人称视频中共同预测接触轨迹和力剖面,将感官估计带入了表达对象的理解. 所学的物理原型在可比较的努力的相互作用中共享有限的仪器测量;几何和视觉语言特征在观测之前就适应了这一点,有条件的流量结合有轨迹加以改进。 VidForce改进了每个基线的轨迹恢复,在被搁置的Hoi!互动中实现了第三人称方法中最小的力差. 一个经过单独训练的扭矩模型进一步表明,该配体可以扩展到其他感官数量. 该模型在现实世界的视频上产生一致的运动和力量预测,使机器人能够安全地表达出物体. 这些结果表明,有限的仪器数据能够如何通过对物体移动方式及其操作可能需要多少努力的估计来丰富普通的交互视频.

blocks.en: Every training sequence supervises the trajectory. Force targets come from the instrumented gripper recordings and, for human recordings that have a gripper recording of the same episode, from that paired recording at half weight; human recordings without a partner supervise the trajectory only. blocks.en: Why a force teacher. Measured during development: without a teacher, the validation force error reached its minimum early in training and had risen by about 15 % by the time the trajectory error converged, so no single checkpoint served both outputs, and freezing the force weights alone did not help because the shared features keep moving. The teacher step is therefore fixed early, where the force error had leveled off in those runs. With the teacher, the force error keeps decreasing slowly after the switch while the trajectory error still falls by roughly half, and the final checkpoint is used for both outputs.
blocks.zh: 何以为力师. 开发期间测量:没有教师,验证力出错在早期训练时达到了最小值,到轨迹出错汇合时上升了约15%,因此没有单一的检查站服务于两种输出,单是冻结力重也无济于事,因为共享特性不断移动. 因此,教师台阶很早就固定了,在这些跑道中,部队出错已经平息。 与老师一起,在开关后力差会持续缓慢地减少,而轨迹出错仍会下降大约一半,最终检查点用于两种输出.

blocks.en: At inference the model needs the clip and, optionally, a contact click and a prompt; either can be generated by the frozen Qwen3-VL-8B. The evaluation protocol for generated inputs is given in Appendix C.13 .

blocks.en: Self-click. The contact is the point Qwen3-VL proposes for where the hand or gripper touches the object. The object-centric window is re-centered on it (side 0.55 × 0.55\times the longer image side) and the tracks and trajectory proposal are recomputed there. A localization head can refine the proposal within 1.5 grid cells, after which the motion field is re-anchored in a second pass; the head is trained on the click-free training rows, where the contact is perturbed by 1.5 grid cells and the click-seeded track tokens are dropped.
blocks.zh: 自击. 接触是Qwen3-VL为手或抓取器触碰对象而提出的点. 以物体为中心的窗口被重置在其上(0.55 × 0.55\时为更长的图像侧),并重置了该地的轨道和轨迹建议. 本地化头可以细化1.5个网格细胞内的建议,之后运动场被二次通过后被重新安心;头被训练到无点击训练行上,接触被1.5个网格细胞所扰动并被点击种子的轨迹标志被丢弃.

blocks.en: Hoi! ( Engelbracht et al., 2026 ) captures people and a hand-held, instrumented gripper operating the same articulated furniture and appliances, filmed by two static third-person cameras. We use the exocentric (third-person) recordings of the hand and Hoi!-gripper embodiments that were available on the Hoi! servers at the time of this work: 25 sessions in 20 indoor scenes, 18 of which have gripper recordings and therefore force measurements. A scene, session, and interaction span define an episode ; our unit, a sequence , is one camera view of an episode in one embodiment (Hoi! counts the two views as one sequence). Nearly every episode was performed by both embodiments, so it has up to four third-person recordings, 1,434 recordings of 395 episodes in total. Gripper recordings carry a tracked tool trajectory and force–torque measurements, human recordings a tracked hand trajectory and no force (below). For 191 recordings the release lacks an input the pipeline needs (gripper calibration or poses, articulation annotation, or hand landmarks); they are set aside before any quality assessment, a matter of availability rather than quality.

blocks.en: B.2 Quality filter

blocks.en: The filter keeps the recordings in which the interaction can actually be seen; in the third-person views the operator often walks the gripper rig between the camera and the object, and hands and contacts leave the frame. Every recording is tested at its annotated contact with a depth-ray gap , the distance between the three-dimensional contact and the depth image at its projection: up to 0.20 m the contact is visible, up to 0.45 m borderline, beyond that occluded. Recordings occluded by the person, with the contact outside the image, with less than half of the articulation path in view, or with an implausibly long path (corrupted tracking) are rejected; borderline gaps are ambiguous; the rest pass. Human recordings are trimmed to the span in which the object moves, from grip onset to the first confident stop, release, or a per-scene cap; the median trimmed span covers 7 of the 16 waypoint frames, whereas gripper spans are used as delimited by the release. Two thirds of the buildable recordings pass, 6 % are ambiguous and unused, and 28 % are rejected; Fig. 5 shows two recordings per tag.

blocks.en: B.3 Sequences, splits, and pairs

blocks.en: A recording becomes a sequence when it passes the filter, can be calibrated, and shows the contact and the object in its first frame (Table 14 ); intrinsics come from the gripper recording of the same episode and camera, so human recordings without a buildable gripper counterpart remain unused. The sequences come from 280 episodes in 17 scenes. Splits were fixed per episode before filtering (Table 15 ): the living room is held out as a whole, and a stratified set of episodes from ten training scenes forms the held-out interactions. Every human recording is paired with the gripper recording of its episode, from the same camera where one exists; the partner’s peak and normalized profile serve as its reference targets and describe gripper force rather than the person’s effort. 201 of the 236 human training sequences have a partner (169 same camera, 32 other camera), and 40 evaluation human sequences have a measured evaluation partner (Appendix C.10 ). The release names no objects; for per-object reporting we name each episode by the part its gripper prompt mentions, with a visual check of the few evaluation episodes without a descriptive prompt. Measured peaks differ between objects and between opening and closing (Table 16 ); the spread within an object and action is what the instance adaptation and the flow have to explain.

blocks.en: Training windows are shifted and rescaled so that the model cannot read the contact off a fixed image position. Each training sequence contributes three windows with side 1.2 1.2 – 2.2 × 2.2\times the canonical window and the contact placed anywhere within the central 70 % of the window, each with its mirror image; trajectories, force profiles, intrinsics, and prompts are transformed consistently, and the canonical window is sampled with probability 0.3. Further perturbations are one-cell contact jitter, log-depth jitter with scale 0.05, and horizontal flips with probability 0.5; the encoder, prompt, prior, and contact-cue dropout rates are listed with the training schedule in Appendix A.4 . The same construction defines the re-framed evaluation set Eval ′ (Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: CoTracker3 with monocular depth. The contact pixel is tracked through the 32 frames with the offline CoTracker3 model, backward from the contact frame, inside the evaluation window; each tracked pixel is lifted with the DA3 depth at that pixel and the frame intrinsics, occluded or invalid depth holds the last valid value, and the sequence is linearly resampled to the 16 waypoint times. The main variant smooths the lifted depth with a five-frame temporal median; the per-frame-depth variant is listed as well.

blocks.en: EgoInfinity. EgoInfinity reconstructs MANO hands from a static-camera video and has no contact interface, so it runs on the 51 human sequences only. Each sequence is encoded as a video of its 32 exported frames and processed with MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) depth and focal length, WiLoR ( Potamias et al., 2025 ) hands with MANO ( Romero et al., 2017 ) , and the pipeline’s motion stabilization; object reconstruction and tracking are disabled. The hand whose 2D joint is nearest the contact at the contact frame is followed and that joint is the contact proxy; sequences without a hand track fall back to the stationary prediction. The main row reads the trajectory in EgoInfinity’s own reconstructed camera; a second row re-projects its joints with our camera intrinsics and rescales the trajectory so that its start depth equals the DA3 depth at the contact.
blocks.zh: 以果无尽. Ego Infinity从静态相机视频中重建出MANO手并没有任何接触界面,因此它只运行于51个人类序列上. 每个序列被编码为其32个出品帧的视频,并用MoGe-2(Wang等,2025年a)深度和焦距,WiLOR(Potamias等,2025年)手与MANO(Romero等,2017年)进行处理,管线运动稳定;物体重建和跟踪被禁用. 2D关节距离接触框最近的手被跟踪,而关节是接触代理;没有手轨的序列会回落到固定的预测. 主行读取EgoInfinity自己重建相机中的轨迹;第二行用相机的内在线段重新投射出相机的关节并重新标出轨迹,使其起始深度等于接触地DA3深度.

blocks.en: Articulate-Anything. The inferred asset is placed at the contact with yaw and scale fitted to the CoTracker3 track, and its trajectory follows the predicted joint range at constant speed. Uncompilable or unrenderable outputs (5 of 99 Eval sequences, 40 of 594 re-framed windows) fall back to the stationary prediction and stay in the denominator, so the comparison includes reconstruction and registration errors.

blocks.en: Global prior with adaptation. This is our own model with the prototypes removed. Instead of K K routed prototypes, every sequence starts from one shared prior: the median measured training peak and the mean normalized training profile, the same statistics that initialize the prototypes, kept fixed during training. Everything else is unchanged and learned as in the main model: the instance adaptation corrects the shared prior from the video features, and the joint flow refines trajectory and force together with the same conditioner, losses, and schedule. The arm therefore isolates what the prototypes and their routing add over a shared starting point that the model still adapts to each video; read before adaptation, its error is that of predicting the training median for every sequence (Table 24 ). It is trained for force and for torque like the main model.
blocks.zh: 全球先于适应. 这是我们自己的模型 原型被拆除。 与K K 路由原型不同的是,每个序列都从一个共享的前端开始:中位测量出的培训峰值和平均正常化的培训配置,与初始化原型相同的统计,在培训期间保持固定. 其他一切照主模型不变并学习:实例适应纠正了视频功能中共享的前作,而联合流会与相同的调理器,损耗,和排程一起细化出轨迹和力. 因此臂将原型及其路由在一个共享的起点上添加的内容隔离出,该模型仍然适应每个视频;在适应前读取,其错误是预测每个序列的训练中位数(表24. 它像主型号一样接受武力和扭力训练。

blocks.en: GPT-5.5. Chat completions with the model snapshot gpt-5.5-2026-04-23 , a strict JSON output schema, and low reasoning effort; eight frames evenly spaced over the articulation span, either the full frame or the object-centric window, with or without the recorded prompt and the object and action words, or the words and the room type alone (text only); the main text quotes the full-frame rows, Table 19 all of them. Three calls per input are averaged (sampling is the model’s default, which cannot be fixed); identical full-frame inputs share calls across re-framed windows. The torque variant asks for the peak torque magnitude about the sensor frame in N m. These are adaptations for peak estimation, not models trained on the Hoi! targets.

ForceSight. ForceSight ( Collins et al., 2024 ) predicts, from one RGB-D frame and an prompt, the force goal of a robot’s next action; the released model is an RGB-D ViT-L with a frozen T5 text encoder, trained on a robot’s wrist camera. Every variant sees frames squashed to 224 2 224^{2} with DA3 depth: in the third-person view the 32 frames of the object window our model sees, and in the gripper-mounted view, the view of the Hoi! zero-shot protocol ( Engelbracht et al., 2026 ) , the whole image at 16 contact-anchored times per episode (39 Eval episodes); the peak is the maximum over frames. Zero-shot rows run the released checkpoint with the authors’ code and score the magnitude of its applied-force goal | F A | |F_{A}| ; Fig. 7 draws its fingertip heat map and force goals. Fine-tuned rows train all weights of the released checkpoint so that | F A | |F_{A}| matches the measured force of each frame; the model keeps its force-goal output and is compared on the peak. Fine-tuning places no loss on the fingertip head, which then finds a fingertip in a quarter of the frames instead of most, so the heat maps in Fig. 7 are those of the zero-shot model. Adapted ForceSight re-implements the architecture with the same ViT-L backbone and frozen T5 text path, replaces the goal outputs, most of which have no labels for human video, with one force output per frame, and trains it from ImageNet-21k initialization; its per-frame predictions form the profile. Fine-tuned and adapted models share data and schedule: in the third-person view, the 496 training sequences with a force target on the object window (295 measured gripper sequences and 201 paired human references at weight 0.5, as for our model); in the gripper-mounted view, the 199 measured training episodes of that view; 8,000 updates, batch 32, L2 loss, AdamW at 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . In both views, adapted ForceSight matches the fine-tuned release within one seed standard deviation in peak error (Table 19 ), so the adaptation does not weaken the baseline; trained on the object window with paired references it is the matched baseline of Table 2 , and trained on the measured rows alone it performs similarly. blocks.en: Controlled comparison. Table 23 compares the learned prototypes with a parameter-matched MLP prior, a fixed global prior (Appendix C.2 ), and the same ten prototypes without ℒ route \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{route}} . The MLP prior replaces the prototype path with one MLP that maps the router’s pooled video features and the prompt embedding to a log-peak offset from the global prior, bounded to a factor of eight, and a 32-sample shape residual; it is zero-initialized, so it starts from the global prior, and its hidden width gives it the same number of parameters as the prototype path. All variants were retrained with the same conditioner, instance adaptation, joint flow, data, and budget. Eval uses manual click and manual prompt; force errors cover 48 instrumented sequences. The full model has the lowest mean peak and profile errors, while ATE varies little across priors (Table 24 ). The peak-MAE ordering also holds on Eval ′ (Table 31 ).

blocks.en: Prediction heads. The study retains the learned prototype prior and instance adaptation and changes the prediction head or its motion cues (Table 30 ). The one-shot head directly regresses the standardized residual target with the same network architecture. The split-flow variant processes trajectory and force tokens in separate streams, retaining the shared conditioner but removing direct exchange between the two outputs; a block-diagonal self-attention mask restricts waypoint and force tokens to their own stream without changing the parameters. blocks.en: Ablation setup. The ablated model is trained on the same 531 sequences as VidForce, with the same videos, trajectory labels, schedule, and settings; only the paired force targets of the 201 human training sequences are removed. The self-distillation teacher of the training schedule (Appendix A.4 ) is kept: from update 2,000 its predictions become the force target of every training sequence, the human ones included, but in this run the teacher is the ablated model’s own average and has never seen a paired reference. blocks.en: D.1 Real-world videos
blocks.zh: D.1 真实世界视频

blocks.en: Seven tripod-mounted phone videos show one person opening and closing six kitchen objects: a refrigerator door, freezer, cabinet door, top drawer, oven door, and dishwasher door. We split them into 46 episodes, from the hand reaching the handle until motion stops, following the motion-span criterion of Appendix B , and sample 32 frames per episode. The manual inputs are the operator’s prompt (e.g., “open the oven door”) and a manually annotated contact pixel on the 640-pixel frame. Self-click uses the vision–language model’s contact proposal; self-prompt asks the model over eight frames what the person does and to which part of which object, without naming the action or appliance. We evaluate all four input combinations on the same episodes, assess repeatability with the manual inputs, and identify action misreads by comparing generated and operator-provided actions.

blocks.en: Wang et al. (2025b) report that force feedback matters for sharp turning motions such as opening a revolute door. Without it, small errors of a predicted trajectory, such as turning too sharply, cause excessive force and stop the arm. Ji et al. (2026) show that a constant force has a failure of its own at first contact. When the desired force steps from 0 N to a constant of 10 or 15 N, the measured force can overshoot to the 20 N safety limit and trigger a protective stop. Like VidForce, they execute a temporal force profile instead; it rises smoothly after contact, and they do not observe this failure. One cause of such an overshoot is that the trajectory term of the controller interferes with the feed-forward: while the hand lags behind its reference, for example at the breakaway, the stiffness adds force on top of the feed-forward. A natural approach is to relatively lower the stiffness in the direction of motion while the feed-forward is on. Their profile study uses whiteboard wiping and carrot peeling, where the tool stays on a surface. Doors and drawers add another issue, the build-up of kinetic energy: under a constant force high enough to open them, the panel hits the end stop with a high impact energy, and a temporal profile keeps it low (Appendix D.3 ). A constant-force controller can be calibrated, but it has to be designed by hand for each task. Ji et al. (2026) also note that, on sustained-contact tasks, a constant force can perform comparably when it is tuned for that specific task.

blocks.en: D.3 Simulation: temporal force profile versus constant feed-forward
blocks.zh: D.3 模拟:时间力剖面与常量进取量

blocks.en: A constant force is the natural control for the predicted force profile: would a constant at the predicted peak, or the category’s mean force, do what the profile does on the robot? The trials of Table 6 compare the profile with a constant force and with no feed-forward; here we answer the question in simulation, in two studies in which every feed-forward runs under the same controller gains, force cap and metrics: hand-built twins with the literature’s mechanism forces, and twins of the Eval episodes driven by the model’s own predictions.
blocks.zh: 恒定力是预测力剖面的自然控制:在预测出峰值时的常数,或该类的平平力,会做该剖面在机器人上做的事吗? 表6的试验将剖面与恒定的力和无向量进行对比;在这里,我们模拟地回答这个问题,在两项研究中,每个向量在相同的控制器增益下运行,强度上限和度量:手造双胞胎与文献的机理力,以及由模型自身预测驱动的Eval事件的双胞胎。

blocks.en: The force that a door or drawer requires is not stationary, and it differs from one object to the next ( Jain et al., 2010 ; Jain & Kemp, 2013 ) . A latch, seal or spring can make the force at the start of the travel far larger than the force behind it: a refrigerator door needs a high force while it is closed and very little after that ( Jain et al., 2010 ) , and so does a drawer on detent slides ( Schweers & Forbes, 2011 ) . A constant pull equal to the breakaway force keeps pulling after the panel has broken free; the surplus work, ∫ ( F − F req ) ​ 𝑑 s \int(F-F_{\mathrm{req}})\,\mathrm{d}s , becomes kinetic energy of the panel, which is dissipated at the end stop or on whatever is in the gap ( Haddadin et al., 2009 ) , and ISO/TS 15066 ( ISO, 2016 ) limits the energy a moving part may transfer to a hand to 0.49 J and the clamping force to 140 N (these limits can be taken as a proxy for a robotic gripper or hand for the analysis). A constant equal to the mean of the profile does not overcome the breakaway force. Only a force that is high at the breakaway and low afterwards does both (a time-varying command, as in learned variable-impedance control; Buchli et al., 2011 ), and that is what the model predicts.
blocks.zh: 门或抽屉所需的力不是固定的,它因物体而异(Jain等,2010;Jain & Kemp,2013.). 接锁,封口或弹簧可以使出行开始时的出行力比出行后的力量要大得多:冰箱门需要高出行力,而闭口后却很少出行(Jain等,2010年),出行后滑行上抽屉也一样出行(Schweers & Forbes,2011年). 与断裂力相等的恒定拉力在面板断裂后不断拉出;剩余活性能(F-F-Req-) d s\int(F-F-_{\-mathrm{req}})\,\mathrm{d}s,成为面板的动能,在末站或空隙中的任何东西上消散(Haddadin等,2009年),而ISO/TS 15066(ISO,2016年),将移动部分可转移给手的能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能自能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能能 与剖面的平均值等同的常数并不能克服分出的力量. 只有一支在分道扬镳时高而后低的军力才能做到两者兼而有之(时间变化的指挥,如在所学可变障碍控制中;Buchli等,2011年),这也是模型预测的.

blocks.en: Both studies run in MuJoCo 3.4 ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) at a time step of 0.2 ms. We did not scan or download any assets: each twin is a small model written by hand from boxes and cylinders, with a cabinet, a panel on a single slide or hinge joint, its handle, and a solid block as the end stop (Fig. 18 ). The joint carries a running friction, a small viscous damping, and a position-dependent resistance that stands for the breakaway force of a latch or seal. On the hand-built twins we set these by hand. The drawer is modeled on a drawer measured on detent slides, which took 34 to 39 N to break out of the detent and then 0.5 to 2.0 N to move along its 28 cm of travel ( Schweers & Forbes, 2011 ) : ours has the same travel, a mass of 4 kg, a breakaway resistance of 36 N that falls linearly to zero over the first 15 mm, and a running friction of 1.5 N. The 9 kg oven door is counterbalanced and has an 18 N latch that falls linearly to zero over its first 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} . Loose contents are free bodies on the drawer floor. On the Eval twins we read them from the force measured in that episode: its 25th percentile while the panel moves is the running friction, and what lies above it is kept as a function of the panel’s position. Each Eval twin takes its travel from the measured trajectory and a typical mass for its object class (3 kg for a cupboard door to 15 kg for a refrigerator door).

blocks.en: The simulated robot runs the controller of the real trials (Appendix D.2 ): a Cartesian impedance law ( Hogan, 1985 ) along the panel’s path, F = m ​ F ff ​ ( t ) + K ⁡ ( s ref − s ) − D ​ s ˙ F=m\,F_{\mathrm{ff}}(t)+K\,(s_{\mathrm{ref}}-s)-D\,\dot{s} , that follows the demonstration’s progress s ref s_{\mathrm{ref}} with the compliant stiffness K = 100 K=100 N/m (30 and 300 N/m where stated) and D D at 0.7 of critical damping. All feed-forwards share these gains, the force cap (100 N on the Eval twins, 40 to 100 N on the hand-built twins) and the margin m = 1.10 m=1.10 , the smallest at which the measured profile completes 90% of the Eval twins (a feed-forward equal to the resistance leaves no net force at the breakaway). On the Eval twins, the conditions differ only in F ff F_{\mathrm{ff}} : the predicted profile, rescaled to the predicted peak and played over the execution window as on the robot; a constant at the predicted peak; a constant at the category mean (the mean predicted force of the other Eval episodes of the same class and action) or at the category peak (the mean training peak of the object and action); the predicted profile with its samples shuffled; the measured profile as an oracle; and no feed-forward. Shuffling keeps the force values, and with them the peak and the mean, and changes only their timing (five random orders, averaged). We record whether the panel reaches the end of its travel, its kinetic energy when it first hits the end stop, the peak force on an ISO/TS 15066 hand model in the gap before the stop, and whether a closing slams into the frame (above 0.49 J).

blocks.en: In the simulation, the robot is reduced to the force it applies: the force of the control law acts at the handle, along its path, with no arm or gripper. On the hand-built twins, the profile comes from a demonstration in the simulator: a stiff position controller pulls the panel open along a minimum-jerk motion (2 s for the drawers, 3 s for the oven door), and the force it needs is reduced to 32 samples, like the model’s output. On the Eval twins, it is the model’s prediction. The feed-forward interpolates the samples over the execution window, and the simulation runs 1.5 s beyond it. An execution succeeds if the panel reaches 95% of its travel in this time. The impact energy is the panel’s kinetic energy just before it first touches the end stop, E = 1 2 ​ m eff ​ v 2 E=\tfrac{1}{2}\,m_{\mathrm{eff}}\,v^{2} , with v v the handle’s speed along its path and m eff m_{\mathrm{eff}} the panel’s mass as felt at the handle (for a door, its moment of inertia about the hinge over the squared handle distance). A panel that never touches the stop counts as 0 J, and loose contents are not included.
blocks.zh: 在模拟中,机器人被降为它所应用的力:控制法的力量在握把上,沿其路径行走,没有手臂或握手. 在手生双胞胎上,剖面图出自模拟器的演示:一个僵硬的位置控制器将面板沿最小的Jerk运动(抽屉为2 s,烤箱门为3 s)拉开,它所需要的力被降低到32个样本,就像模型的输出. Eval双胞胎是模型的预测。 饲料向上将样品插到执行窗口上,模拟运行在1.5秒外. 如果此时面板达到95%的行程,则执行成功. 撞击能是板子在第一次触动末站前的动能, E = 1 2 m eff v 2 E=\tfrac{ 1}{2}\, m_{\-mathrm{eff}}\,v^{2} 并vv 指柄沿途行走速度和 m eff m_{\-mathrm{eff} (对于一扇门,它对于正方形手柄相距上的链条的惯性时刻)。 从未触及站点的面板计为 0 J , 且不包含松散的内容 。

blocks.en: Table 51 and Fig. 19 isolate the mechanism on the four hand-built twins (Fig. 18 ): the drawer, empty, with loose cans and boxes, or with a free 35 kg block, and the oven door. On each, the demonstrated profile is compared with a constant at its peak or its mean, its shuffled samples and no feed-forward. At K = 100 K=100 N/m, a constant at the peak keeps pulling after the breakaway: the three drawers exceed both ISO hand limits, the contents slide into the drawer walls, and the block strikes the drawer front. A stiffer controller ( K = 300 K=300 N/m) keeps the two lighter drawers within the limits, but not the one with the 35 kg block. A constant at the mean, like no feed-forward, does not overcome the drawers’ breakaway at K = 100 K=100 N/m. The demonstrated profile opens all four twins with almost no impact, while the same forces in a shuffled order open them but hit the stop: the timing of the force matters, not only its values.
blocks.zh: 表51和图19隔离了四个手生双胞胎(图18)上的机制:抽屉,空出,有松散的罐子和箱子,或有免费的35公斤块,还有烤箱门. 每一个样本上,所显示的剖面图都与峰值或平均值的常数、其被洗涤的样本和没有饲料向后比较。 在K = 100 K = 100 N/m时,峰值上的一个常数在断开后不断拉出:三个抽屉都超过了ISO的手限,内容会滑入抽屉的墙上,被块打出抽屉前. 一个更僵硬的控制器(K = 300 K = 300 N/m)将两个更轻的抽屉保留在限制范围内,但不能使用有35公斤块的抽屉. K=100K=100 N/m。 被演示的剖面打开了所有四个几乎没有撞击的双胞胎,而同一种被打乱的顺序下的力量打开了它们但击中了站:力量的时机很重要,不仅仅是其价值.

blocks.en: On the twin of each instrumented Eval episode, the simulated robot executes the model’s prediction for that episode (Table 52 ). Played against time, the predicted profile completes most episodes, with no impact above the 0.49 J limit and no slammed closing; it stalls on the others, the oven twins among them. Indexed by the panel’s progress instead, it completes nearly every episode (96%), the oven twins included, at the same low impact energy. No constant does both. A constant at the predicted or the category peak completes every episode, but at twice the impact energy, with impacts above the limit and slammed closings. A constant at the category mean is as gentle as the profile, because it leaves most of the work to the position loop, but it never opens the oven twins, even when indexed by progress, and at K = 30 K=30 N/m it completes fewer episodes than the profile. The shuffled profile, with the same forces in a random order, hits harder than the profile, and without feed-forward the compliant controller opens fewer than half of the episodes.
blocks.zh: 模拟机器人在每集仪器Eval的双相上执行模型对该集的预测(表52). 与时俱进地播放,预测的剖面完成大部分镜头,没有超过0.49J极限的撞击,也没有被撞倒;它拖住其他镜头,即其中的烤箱双胞胎. 几乎每集(96%), 烤箱双胞胎的能量都很低。 二者无常相. 预测或分类峰值的常数会完成每集,但撞击能量会达到两倍,撞击会超过极限并猛烈收尾. 分类平均值的常数与剖面图一样温和,因为它将大部分作品留给了位置回路,但是它从未打开烤箱双胞胎,即使按照进度索引,在K=30K=30N/m时,它完成的插曲也比剖面图少. shuffled profile 以相同的力量随机排列,比 profile 更猛烈地点击,没有feed-forward,兼容控制器打开不到一半的分集.

blocks.en: The twins are single-joint models with category masses and the literature’s mechanism forces; the simulated robot has no joint-level dynamics, grasp compliance or sensing noise.
